svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Laser cut a 318 x 176 plate from 6 mm acrylic with 8 mm holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on a 24 mm grid (13 x 7, none at the four corners over the legs).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Engrave six bay outlines 90 x 70, 12 apart and 12 from the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut four legs 10 x 10 x 50 and a cable rail 318 x 25 x 12.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld a leg under each corner, 10 in from both edges, and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail along the back edge, standing up from the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill and tap two M4 holes in the rail's back face, on its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle, 6 and 19 up from its lower edge, for the mast.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the legs stand loose on the chamber floor, so the tray

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lifts out through the door. Plate top 56 above the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the tray stands level and does not rock.
